-- 2020 projects

-- The Penelopiad (already has 6 tags, skip)

-- Macbeth
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Macbeth' AND t.name IN ('Shakespeare', '2020', 'Tragedy', 'Scottish', 'University Theatre', 'Dark')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- 2019 projects

-- Company (already has 6 tags, skip)

-- Urinetown
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Urinetown' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2019', 'Satire', 'Dystopian', 'Political Satire', 'University Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- The Crucible
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'The Crucible' AND t.name IN ('Drama', '2019', 'Arthur Miller', 'Historical', 'Salem Witch Trials', 'University Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
